verdict.rationale: Composio documents white-labeling of the authentication flow: you can swap in your logo and app title and restyle the hosted Connect page to match your product. However, nothing in the pack documents bringing your own OAuth app credentials (client ID/secret) so the provider consent screen shows your app, which is half of the story. missing for 10: documented support for custom OAuth app credentials, coverage of all four branding touchpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials

citations.quote: You can swap in your logo and name, then restyle the whole page to match your product.
